pages.title: Words and Bubbles
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description:
Words and Bubbles is a word-association puzzle about finding connections between meanings. Identify words that belong together and merge their bubbles to reveal a category. Completed categories can then become parts of further combinations, extending the chain of associations.

The challenge is to notice a shared idea rather than spell a word from letters. A connection that solves one group may also help you recognize a larger relationship among the remaining bubbles. Work through the available words at your own pace and keep looking for links that only become clear after another merge.

pages.title: Hidden Object Adventure
pages.creator: Susa Games
pages.description: Search themed scenes in Hidden Object Adventure. Check the on-screen item list and select each object concealed in the picture. Explore places such as houses, schools, amusement parks, and zoos, using hints when a required item is difficult to spot.

pages.title: Stand on the Right Color, Robby!
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Race across disappearing tiles in Stand on the Right Color, Robby! Move to the indicated safe color whenever it changes and avoid falling from the course. Reach the finish ahead of rivals and spend earned currency on skins, items, and effects.

pages.title: Airport Security
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Check travelers in Airport Security. Examine passports for false information and use the X-ray machine to uncover prohibited items. Decide which passengers need attention as you work through the terminal's screening tasks.

pages.title: Build A Queen 2025
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Build the requested royal look in Build A Queen 2025. Move through platform courses and choose clothes, skin tones, and other appearance details that suit the goal. Collect money for additional dance moves and reach the prince with the completed outfit.

pages.title: Hyper Nurse: Hospital Games
pages.creator: Geniteam
pages.description: Manage patient care in Hyper Nurse: Hospital Games. Make choices with the mouse while handling the hospital's requests and changing situations. Balance the different tasks so the patients receive attention and the ward keeps operating.

pages.title: Around Elbrus
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Descend a snowy mountain in Around Elbrus. Jump over rocks and avoid cliffs and avalanches while gathering coins. Perform somersaults for extra acceleration and maneuverability as you continue down the mountain's hazardous path.

pages.title: Jelly Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Combine matching pieces in Jelly Block Puzzle. Connect same-colored jellies until you meet the required number of combinations for a level. Use the removal power-up on a selected jelly or swap two pieces when the arrangement needs changing.

pages.title: Ladder Master - Color Run
pages.creator: Tummy Games DOO
pages.description: Build height while running in Ladder Master - Color Run. Gather ladder sections matching your color and steer around obstacles on the course. Grow the ladder so you can continue toward the finishing pot of gold.

pages.title: Practice On Me
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create three summer makeovers in Practice On Me. Try festival, beach, and flower-inspired themes using the available makeup. Combine lip colors and other beauty choices to finish a distinct look for each setting.

pages.title: Gun War Z1
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Clear infected areas in Gun War Z1. Shoot zombies and rescue people as the outbreak spreads between locations. Aim with the mouse and launch a rocket with A when the fighting calls for extra firepower.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Valentine
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Clear romantic bubble formations in Bubble Shooter Valentine. Click or tap to aim a shot into a cluster of the same color. Keep removing matching groups until the board's remaining bubbles are cleared.

pages.title: Catch The Cat
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Locate a slippery pet in Catch The Cat. Examine each puzzle scene and interact with the objects that help you catch it. Consider the cat's position and the available tools before choosing the next action.

pages.title: Thief Puzzle Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Retrieve valuables in Thief Puzzle Online. Drag the stickman's hand toward the item while planning a route through the scene's hazards. Adjust the hand's movement to reach the prize without being stopped by the obstacles.

pages.title: Flag Capture
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Steal and return banners in Flag Capture. Fight through the opposing side, take its flag, and deliver it to your own base while protecting your team's banner. Use different weapons to interrupt rivals, with the first side to five captures winning.

pages.title: Bubble Pop Classic
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Use the aiming guide in Bubble Pop Classic. Fire colored bubbles into matching clusters to remove them and open the formation. Work through the handmade boards by choosing a useful landing position for each shot.

pages.title: BFF Pajama Party
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style a group for BFF Pajama Party. Choose comfortable sleepwear that reflects each girl's personality, from colorful clown-inspired pieces to animal prints and darker outfits. Prepare their looks for an evening of makeup, movies, and pillow fights.

pages.title: 2D Dark Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race across poorly lit hills in 2D Dark Racing. Keep the headlights on the route, gather fuel, and use nitro or jumps to handle difficult sections. Perform flips for extra money and spend the proceeds on upgrades.

pages.title: Noob Vs Pro 4 Lucky Block
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Recover a stolen prize in Noob Vs Pro 4 Lucky Block. Follow Noob and Pro through traps, pig rides, and a secret mine in search of the Hacker's loot. Complete the story's trials to find and open the Lucky Block.

pages.title: Princess Lovely Fashion
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Create a complete makeover in Princess Lovely Fashion. Choose makeup, clothing, and a hairstyle for the character, then take a picture of the finished look. Try the available photo effects to change the final presentation.

pages.title: Heroes of Mangara
pages.creator: NOXGAMES
pages.description: Defend a troubled kingdom in Heroes of Mangara. Place heroes inside towers and use apprentices for extra damage or healing support. Develop the heroes' skills while stopping enemy armies across the lands of Mangara.

pages.title: Impostor Hook
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Catch opponents across a gap in Impostor Hook. Position the character and let the automatically thrown chain pull a rival onto your side. Avoid enemy hooks that briefly imprison you, and spend earned points on fifteen character unlocks.

pages.title: Demon Killer
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Stop a supernatural invasion in Demon Killer. Shoot demons to earn gold, then buy ammunition and improve your weapons in the menu. Aim for headshots to deal additional damage as the attackers advance.

pages.title: Erase One Part!
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Reveal puzzle solutions in Erase One Part! Read the current scene's instruction and remove the relevant portion of the drawing. Use the erasing action to uncover what is hidden and complete the level's task.

pages.title: Philatelic Escape Fauna Album 4
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Search another apartment in Philatelic Escape Fauna Album 4. Open the entrance, explore cupboards and shelves, and collect objects that help solve the room's codes. Find all ten postage stamps while working through numeric and letter puzzles.

pages.title: Running Jump
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Climb before the spikes arrive in Running Jump. Leap between platforms and jump onto patrolling enemies to destroy them. Keep gaining height ahead of the rising danger while trying to clear more platforms and opponents.

pages.title: Falling Down Stairs Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Navigate an endless staircase in Falling Down Stairs Online. Drag to control your route and keep away from spikes and the edges. Work around other characters as you try to extend the high-score attempt.

pages.title: Drop Guys: Knockout Tournament
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Race competing chicks in Drop Guys: Knockout Tournament. Use the direction keys and space bar to move and jump through the courses. Try different modes and beat the other runners to become the tournament winner.

pages.title: Crowd City
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Gather followers in Crowd City. Move around town inviting people into your group, then absorb crowds smaller than your own. Stay away from larger opponents while building enough numbers to become the city's biggest gathering.

pages.title: Stretch Guy
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Climb with an elastic character in Stretch Guy. Drag individual limbs onto supporting walls and move them in sequence to make progress. Keep each stretch within the body's limits so it does not pull apart.

pages.title: Scatty Maps Japan
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Place prefectures on a country map in Scatty Maps Japan. Drag each region to its correct location, choosing an easy or complete version in English or Japanese. Enable border help or zoom for guidance, and read the accompanying geographic information.

pages.title: Ragdoll Gangs
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight loose-limbed opponents in Ragdoll Gangs. Try six solo adventure stages with different brawling tasks, or enter an arena match against the computer or a friend. Use the physics-driven fights to knock out or throw away the opposition.

pages.title: Quick Dice
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Time colored dice against a rotating wheel in Quick Dice. Release each die when the section matching its color is in position. Try quick, speed, or time-attack play and build a better result with more accurate timing.

pages.title: Xtreme Roll Ball ZigZag
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Keep a small ball on a narrow track in Xtreme Roll Ball ZigZag. Use the mouse to guide its direction along the changing road. React before the next bend, because falling beyond the edge ends the game.

pages.title: Little Corona Girl Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Keep the heroine airborne in Little Corona Girl Game. Click to lift her and guide the flight around the virus hazards. Time each upward movement to pass the next obstacle and protect the girl along the route.

pages.title: Monster Party Puzzle
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Rebuild twelve illustrated scenes in Monster Party Puzzle. Choose a picture and a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece layout. Fit the scattered parts together to complete the monster image.

pages.title: World Earth Day Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six pictures in World Earth Day Puzzle. Choose an image and a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout, then arrange the scattered sections. Match the visible details to rebuild the complete scene.

pages.title: Math Train Addition
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Solve a moving arithmetic task in Math Train Addition. Read the addition problem and tap when its correct answer passes above the balloon. Collect stars for extra points and avoid wrong answers that reduce health before the timer ends.

pages.title: Fill 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Cover the entire board in Fill 3D. Move with the arrow keys to spread across its open spaces while avoiding obstacles. Work out a route that reaches every required square and completes the puzzle.

pages.title: Four In A Row
pages.creator: Theplaygame.com
pages.description: Connect four pieces before your opponent in Four In A Row. Place your next ball to build a line while blocking the other side's progress. Play against a friend or challenge the computer.

pages.title: Football Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange football pictures in Football Slide. Select one of three images and a puzzle mode, then slide its tiles into position. Follow the picture's features to restore the complete scene.

pages.title: Drawing For Kids
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Trace a character step by step in Drawing For Kids. Follow the drawing activity to make animals, vehicles, and other pictures. Watch the completed character animate, such as a fluttering butterfly or a rocket taking off.

pages.title: BTS Dotted Girl Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color scenes from a superhero's life in BTS Dotted Girl Coloring. Choose the shades you want and apply them to the outlined picture with mouse or touch input. Work through the details to finish your own version of the illustration.

pages.title: Flying Easter Bunny
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Keep a rabbit airborne in Flying Easter Bunny. Click and hold to move the character and collect eggs along the route. Gather more eggs during the flight to raise your score.

pages.title: Neon Blaster 2
pages.creator: GAMEE
pages.description: Blast incoming targets in Neon Blaster 2. Keep firing to clear the route and strengthen your cannon through upgrades. Return with the improved weapon to tackle the increasingly demanding shooting challenge.

pages.title: Polyshapes
pages.creator: Ouzo games
pages.description: Uncover a hidden design in Polyshapes. Tap selected sections of the divided picture to reveal the colored shape beneath. Examine the outlines and continue choosing the pieces that belong to the image.

pages.title: Neon Path
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Guide a glowing object through a narrow course in Neon Path. Use the mouse to navigate the route and collect diamonds. Keep clear of the neon walls so the attempt can continue.

pages.title: Cool GTA Cars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Assemble a car picture in Cool GTA Cars. Choose a difficulty that sets the puzzle's complexity, then fit the scattered pieces into the complete vehicle image. Compare edges and picture details to find the remaining placements.

pages.title: Ship Factory Tycoon
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Turn plans into vessels in Ship Factory Tycoon. Build a ship using an available blueprint and sell the finished craft to a customer. Spend the earnings on new plans and repeat the process with another design.

pages.title: Easter Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a springtime illustration in Easter Coloring Book. Select brush colors and fill the picture's outlined sections with your own palette. Use mouse or touch controls to finish the chosen Easter artwork.

pages.title: Star Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pilot a ship through retro-style combat in Star Shooter. Use WASD to change position and the space bar to fire. Keep attacking the opposing targets as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Soccer Match 3
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Make same-colored groups in Soccer Match 3. Arrange at least three matching pieces in a row to add points and sustain the left-side meter. Keep making combinations before that meter drops low enough to end the game.

pages.title: Rolling Ball
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Balance an acrobat in Rolling Ball. Keep the rider steady on top of the moving ball as the platform changes beneath it. Adjust to the movement and try to continue without losing the character's balance.

pages.title: Tunnel
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Dodge incoming obstacles in Tunnel. Steer through the passage and react to gaps in the approaching barriers. Keep the endless run going to increase your score before a collision stops the attempt.

pages.title: Archery Master
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Practice bow shooting in Archery Master. Aim at the targets and choose between distance, arcade, and timed play. Adjust your shots to the selected mode as you work toward a better shooting result.

pages.title: NEW YEARS PUZZLES
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: Choose a seasonal challenge in NEW YEARS PUZZLES. Search unopened boxes for the penguin, pair matching decorations, slide a picture into place, or rotate its tiles. Each activity has different rules for completing the holiday puzzle.

pages.title: Pizza Mania
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Run a busy food counter in Pizza Mania. Read customers' orders and prepare pizzas with the requested ingredients. Complete each pizza and serve it before moving on to another customer's request.

pages.title: Knife Jump
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Climb with a blade in Knife Jump. Time the knife's upward movement and work toward the top of the route. Keep the jumps controlled so the next attempt carries it higher.

pages.title: QuickMath
pages.creator: Dreamly Games
pages.description: Practice five types of arithmetic in QuickMath. Answer questions covering addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and mixed operations. Choose a category and work through the available problems to test your calculation skills.

pages.title: Simon Says Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Repeat a growing pattern in Simon Says Challenge. Watch and listen as the game presents its sequence, then select the same steps in order. Remember the earlier inputs as more are added to the challenge.

pages.title: Dominoes Deluxe
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Play tile-matching table games in Dominoes Deluxe. Choose a mode and its settings, then connect dominoes according to the selected rules. Plan around the numbers in your hand as you take turns with the opposing side.

pages.title: War Zone
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Defend territory from an armed assault in War Zone. Enter the hostile area and use the available weapons against attacking militants. Keep eliminating the opposition to protect the position you are defending.

pages.title: Bff Princess Vote For football 2018
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Support a chosen team in Bff Princess Vote For football 2018. Help Moana, Elsa, and Rapunzel pick outfits representing their World Cup favorites. Finish the football-inspired looks for the pictures they plan to share.

pages.title: Geometry Fresh
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Turn symbols into arithmetic in Geometry Fresh. Count the objects matching the displayed shape, color, or both to find each symbol's value. Use those totals to solve addition, subtraction, and multiplication questions and choose the correct answer.

pages.title: Wood Slide
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Open a route for the green piece in Wood Slide. Swipe wooden blocks out of its way, then slide it toward the exit. Solve forty-five layouts by planning which pieces need room before moving the target block.

pages.title: Maserati Gran Turismo 2018
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Compete in a sports car in Maserati Gran Turismo 2018. Steer through races and earn money from your results. Continue toward harder circuits and stronger opponents as you build your racing progress.

pages.title: Powerbots
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Lead a robotic defense in Powerbots. Position your team and use its different abilities to protect the base. Attack the hostile planet's insects and reptiles before they overwhelm the robots' position.

pages.title: Farm Connect
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear animal-themed tiles in Farm Connect. Find identical pet pictures and connect available pairs to remove them. Continue through the different designs until the full arrangement has been cleared.

pages.title: Ice Princess Fruity Skin Care
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Help Anna through a beauty routine in Ice Princess Fruity Skin Care. Prepare the game's fruit-based face mixture and apply it during the makeover activities. Finish by choosing an outfit to go with her refreshed look.

pages.title: Princesses Perfect Tanning
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare two friends for the beach in Princesses Perfect Tanning. Choose swimsuits, hairstyles, and drinks for their relaxing day. Complete the outfits before the princesses take selfies to share from their outing.
